Alcoholic.name: Apple Cider Honey Whiskey
directions: Add all ingredients to a crockpot and cook on Low for 2–3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the honey to reach your desired level of sweetness.
Serve warm and garnish with apples.

Alcoholic.name: Peach Pie Moonshine
directions: In a large stockpot, combine the juice, peaches, sugar, brown sugar, and cinnamon sticks. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30–60 minutes.
Remove the cinnamon sticks and allow the mixture to cool to room temperature.
Stir in the peach schnapps and Everclear.
Strain the mixture through cheesecloth to remove small pieces of peaches.
Ladle into jars and add 2–3 peach slices to each jar.
Yields approximately 12–14 pint mason jars.

Shots.name: Chocolate Pudding Shots
directions: In a large bowl, whisk the pudding mix and milk together until smooth. Let stand for 5 minutes to thicken.
Stir in the vodka and Irish cream until well combined.
Fold in the whipped topping until evenly incorporated.
Fill 2-ounce cups, place lids on, and freeze until ready to serve.
Optional: Let sit at room temperature for a few minutes before serving if frozen solid.
